title: schoenorchis minutiflora
intro: Schoenorchis minutiflora, commonly known as the small-flowered orchid, is a plant species in the Asparagaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Schoenorchis minutiflora include wound healing, anti-hyperglycemic, and anti-hypertensive effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
